question: Early on Monday morning a builder's yard took in 9 pallets of paving slabs, each pallet holding 109 slabs. Before lunch 674 slabs were sent out to a driveway job. In the afternoon the yard ordered enough slabs for the stack to hold 7 times as many as were left. A neighbour returned 52 slabs that evening to the yard, which is 40 metres wide. The following week the stack was built up to 3 times that size for the summer. A housing site then took 1079 slabs away. How many paving slabs are left in the yard?

A school hall keeps all of its stacking chairs in one store, and the caretaker logs his work in hours rather than in minutes. On Monday morning the store held 101 chairs, and 9 more were carried in from a classroom. At lunchtime half of the chairs in the store were taken out for an assembly and never brought back. On Tuesday the school bought enough chairs for the store to hold 4 times as many as remained. On Wednesday afternoon 30 chairs arrived from a school that had closed, and that evening a parents' group donated 37 more. How many chairs are in the store now?

Ingrid's almond farm produces more than her cousin Pavel's does. She filled a sack with 125 kilograms of almonds and added 28 kilograms from the last tree. Each of the 9 fields on her farm yields a sack of exactly that size, and she owns 9 farms of the same size across the valley. Last year 4130 kilograms of that harvest went mouldy in storage and were thrown out. A buyer has now ordered 4 times as much as Ingrid has left. How many kilograms of almonds does the buyer's order come to?

Marco's pizzeria gets through more dough than Lidia's cafe does. On Friday Marco prepared 69 pizza bases, and for Saturday's football crowd he doubled that number. Customers bought 89 of the bases over the weekend, and 17 more were used for staff meals. Marco divided everything that was left equally between his 2 chest freezers. How many pizza bases went into one freezer?

On Monday morning a library trolley held 112 DVDs waiting to be shelved. Before lunch 56 more DVDs were returned to the trolley. During the afternoon a donation added 13 DVDs and a school returned 8 more. On Tuesday evening a video shop that was closing gave the library 36 DVDs, which went onto the same trolley. How many DVDs are on the trolley now?

On Saturday morning Aziz counted 139 toffees in the sweet shop jar, and his sister Yara tipped in 31 more, though Aziz eats more of them than Yara does. Before lunch 85 toffees were sold to a coach party. In the afternoon 11 toffees were found stuck together and were thrown away. That evening the shop filled 8 jars, each holding as many toffees as the first jar. On Sunday 577 toffees were sold from those jars. How many toffees are left?

On Friday morning 231 passengers were booked on the island ferry. By the time it was due to sail, 206 of them had taken the earlier boat instead. Before noon another 14 booked passengers cancelled. In the afternoon 21 walk-up passengers bought tickets for that same sailing. The company now plans 9 sailings a week, each carrying as many passengers as that one did. How many passengers will the 9 sailings carry in total?

On the morning of the concert the box office had 9 rolls of wristbands, each roll holding 202 wristbands, all kept in one drawer. A sponsor added 34 wristbands to the drawer before the gates opened. The venue has 5 entrances. During the afternoon 1007 wristbands were handed out at the main gate. In the evening another 361 were given out at the side gates. How many wristbands are left in the drawer?

A garden shop keeps all of its bird feeders on one stand. On Saturday morning the stand held 126 feeders, and 112 were sold in a rush before lunch. In the afternoon a supplier delivered 57 more feeders for the stand. Twice during the day a customer asked for a feeder that was out of stock. That evening 18 feeders were sold, and on Sunday another 17 went. How many bird feeders are on the stand now?

Yusra makes more cheeses each month than her partner Ollie does. The cellar held 47 wheels of cheese at the start of the year, and a new batch added 71 more. The dairy then made enough for the cellar to hold 9 times as many wheels as it did. Half of the wheels in the cellar were sent away to a distributor. Over the summer 411 wheels were sold at the farm gate. How many wheels of cheese are in the cellar now?

On Monday morning the harbour store held 148 boxes of ice, and half of them melted when the freezer failed, though Kemal keeps a fuller store than his colleague Ana does. By the afternoon the supplier had delivered enough for the store to hold 7 times as many boxes as were left. That evening head office topped it up again so that the store held 9 times that number. Over the next week 4228 boxes were used by the trawlers and 417 more went to the fish market. The company now wants 5 stores holding as many boxes as this one has left. How many boxes of ice will the 5 stores hold?

Ada digs more potatoes on the allotment than her neighbour Piotr does. The sack by the gate held 66 potatoes on Monday. Ada added 19 potatoes and Piotr added 25 more to the same sack. On Wednesday another 11 went in, and on Friday a further 34. The allotment path is 40 metres long. The society now wants 8 sacks filled to match this one. How many potatoes will the 8 sacks hold?

A parking meter company counts its takings in whole dollars rather than in cents. One meter held 238 coins on Friday, and a collector dropped in 13 more that had jammed earlier. On Saturday 127 coins were taken out to pay a contractor. The rest were shared equally between the 4 offices in the town, and one office locked its share in a safe. That office then spent 5 coins on stamps and lost 4 down a drain. How many coins does that office have now?

A pharmacy records its stock in single bottles rather than in cases, and Salma fills more prescriptions than her colleague Dan does. The shelf held 106 bottles of cough syrup in October, and 61 were dispensed that month. A delivery in November brought 68 more bottles to the shelf. The pharmacy is open 6 days a week. In December 60 bottles were dispensed, and in January a wholesaler sent 46 bottles. How many bottles of cough syrup are on the shelf now?

Ruth organises more races than her co-organiser Emeka does. The medal box held 202 medals before the marathon, and half of them were given out at the finish line. A sponsor then sent 61 new medals for the box. A club returned 9 medals that had been engraved wrongly, and the engraver delivered 29 more. A school finally donated 71 spare medals to the same box. How many medals are in the box now?

Ingrid keeps more buttons in her sewing box than her sister Marta does. The box held 229 buttons until 147 were sewn onto a coat order. A haberdasher then tripled the number of buttons in the box. Marta borrowed 64 buttons for a costume and never brought them back. A theatre has now ordered 5 boxes, each holding as many buttons as Ingrid's box does. How many buttons will the theatre's order come to?

A vending company loads 143 cans onto each of the 5 shelves of a machine. There are 4 machines of that kind in the college. The company also left 60 spare cans in the college store. The college has 900 students. Demand was so high that the company doubled the whole stock it keeps at the college. A technician then added 3 cans he found in his van. How many cans are at the college now?

On Saturday morning a beach clean began with 100 pieces of litter already in the bin, and before nine o'clock Ivy collected 68 pieces while Callum collected 71, since Callum works faster than Ivy does. The beach is 2 kilometres long. At midday a family added 27 pieces to the bin. In the afternoon a diver brought up 30 pieces from the harbour. In the evening a dog walker added 33 more. How many pieces of litter are in the bin now?

Femi's chocolate line runs faster than Greta's does. The mixing room held 94 slabs of chocolate, and 61 of them were used for a special order. Each remaining slab is cut into 6 bars. A batch of that size is made on each of the 5 lines, and the factory runs 7 such batches every week. Last week 5175 bars were shipped out to shops. How many bars are still in the factory?

A car wash sells its tokens in whole dollars rather than in cents. On Monday morning the kiosk held 108 tokens, and a customer returned 7 unused ones. Before lunch a taxi firm used 24 tokens. In the afternoon the owner ordered enough tokens for the kiosk to hold 6 times as many as were left. That evening the same stock was arranged for each of the 5 kiosks in the chain, and the chain repeated the whole order in all 4 towns where it operates. How many tokens does the chain now hold?

On Friday morning a campsite had 224 pitches free. By lunchtime a festival crowd had booked 91 pitches, and 7 more were taken in the early afternoon. That evening 26 groups left the site and their pitches became free again. On Saturday another 77 pitches were booked. How many pitches are free now?

A bakery cut 9 large cakes into 111 slices each for a wedding. The guests ate 925 slices during the reception. A further 65 slices were boxed up and taken home by the family. The wedding had 300 guests. The slices that were left were shared equally between the 3 kitchen staff. How many slices did one member of the kitchen staff receive?

Rita's dog eats more treats than Sam's dog does. Rita had 28 treats in the tin, and 3 of them were crushed and thrown away. Sam then doubled the number of treats in the tin with a bag he had bought. A neighbour added 7 home-baked treats, and the pet shop delivered another 67. How many treats are in the tin now?

A minibus company counts its takings in whole dollars rather than in cents. Each of the 9 drivers brought in 218 dollars on Monday, and all of it went into one account. A passenger then paid 77 dollars for a group booking. Fuel for the week cost the company 1686 dollars. Over the following month the account grew to 5 times what it held, and repairs then took 1533 dollars out of it. The owners shared what was left equally between the 2 partners. How many dollars did one partner receive?

A stationery factory keeps all of its sticker sheets in one warehouse. The first machine printed 137 sheets and the second machine doubled that number. Every one of those sheets was then reprinted for each of the 8 designs in the range. The factory has 3 loading doors. The whole print run was repeated for each of the 7 countries the company sells to, and then again for each of the 8 languages the stickers are printed in. How many sticker sheets are in the warehouse?
